Re-review of git diff 49fc058f..c5871cd8 on branch RHLGA-P6-rhl6:
1. Finding (a) is resolved in src/rhl/contract_tests.rs:53-56: RHL_REQUIRE_PV=1 turns a missing pv binary into an explicit assertion failure, preventing silent skips in CI / release gate.
2. Finding (b) is resolved in src/rhl/codes.rs:64-65: CATALOGUE comment was updated to accurately state that codes are ordered by allocation (family originals first, followed by appends).
3. Amendment A5 in docs/specifications/ruchy-high-level-language-interface.md:441-450 is an honest record that accurately explains why and how F6 is measured (pv validate exit 0 && pv status Proof obligations >= 1 due to SHACL shapes_n being 0 across the corpus), maps C002 to NoContractTemplate, explicitly records the 2:1 ruling and the dissent, and does not overclaim.
4. docs/rhl/PREREGISTRATION.sha256 changed only the single hash line for docs/specifications/ruchy-high-level-language-interface.md, matching its updated sha256 checksum.
Verdict: PASS.
